citation: Liu X, et al. Acute Peanut Consumption Alters Postprandial Lipids and Vascular Responses in Healthy Overweight or Obese Men. J Nutr 2017.
protocol: Overnight fast (10-12 h); shake meal of 1198 kcal (40.0% carbohydrate, 47.7% fat, 13.2% protein; peanut vs energy- and macronutrient-matched control), crossover; samples 0, 30, 60, 120, 240 min
population: n=15 healthy overweight/obese men, mean age 26.7 y, mean BMI 31.4
note: Both curves to 240 min in a table with SEM and a printed large mixed meal; the control shake is the macronutrient-matched arm. BMI is above 30, so a reader should enter it as the paper's population, not as lean.
